addition.item: ⁠The newsletter: for each article published in a watched category, subscribers to that topic receive an email with the title, introduction, image and a button to read it.
⁠Sign-up through a Formulus form, « Newsletter topics » field, double opt-in, one-click unsubscribe in every email.
⁠« Newsletter: Subscribers » and « Newsletter: Sendings » screens: follow each article, test to your own address, retry failures, export.
⁠« Invite a group »: each account of a user group receives its invitation and subscribes in one click, with its address.
⁠Home page: the « Joomanji updates » box lists the pending updates of your Joomanji products, with an « Update all » button. Joomla does the update.

change.item: ⁠« Survey » template: a consent box replaces the terms of sale box.
⁠Clearer field errors, and a message when a required field is left empty.

note.item: ⁠The newsletter is off by default: switch it on in the Formulus Options, « Newsletter » tab. It relies on the Joomla task scheduler.

addition.item: ⁠“Texts” tab (formerly “Form”): a “Closing text” shows under the form and disappears after a successful submission.

change.item: ⁠A single-choice drop-down list starts with “Choose”; when required, it refuses to submit until something is chosen.
⁠Fields come out in the order of the list, even when placed in another group.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. Nothing to set again.

fix.item: ⁠Works with the JCE editor: Formulus took it for TinyMCE, the Joomla editor, and tried to drop its cards into it. That confusion could stop JCE from starting.
⁠Under JCE the “Formulus: place a form” button works; form cards stay a TinyMCE feature.

addition.item: ⁠Form screen: an Options button, and a Preview button.
⁠A click inside “What will come out” takes you to that field line.

change.item: ⁠Folded sections stay folded from one opening to the next.
⁠The width handle of the “Formulus: place a form” panel is in the site language.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. A site still on Joomla 6.1 keeps its current version and is offered nothing that could break it.

addition.item: ⁠A “Formulus: place a form” button in the editor: start from a template or from an existing form and place it in the article.
⁠Each placed form becomes a card in the editor: move it, edit it, preview it or remove it.
⁠In the module list, a note says which article each form is placed in.

change.item: ⁠The preview shows the form with the site template.
⁠“Edit” opens the form on the Fields tab.

note.item: ⁠Two plugins join the package and enable themselves. Ready for Joomla 6.2. Nothing to set again.
